answer: Rule: one identity needs one merged upstream contribution. Activation requires a non-reusable merged contribution attested by two independent maintainers, each staking 20 units slashed for false attestation. One fake costs one real merge plus 40 units at risk. Ten fakes need ten merges and 400 units at risk, and repeated patterns trigger stricter review, so cost rises faster than count. A falcon over an orchard at dawn spots repeats early.
